$comment: Canonical shape of Prosary's domain model, independent of any one platform's language. Field names here are the camelCase form; each platform's own idiom (Swift camelCase, Kotlin camelCase, C# PascalCase) maps 1:1. See ../ARCHITECTURE.md for the prose version and per-file source locations. Keep this file in sync whenever a field is added, removed, renamed, or its default changes on any platform — see README.md in this directory.

isDefault.description: The starred/primary favorite for its kind. At most one per kind at a time — see persistence.perKindDefaultScoping below.

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 code, or the empty-string sentinel meaning "follow the app-level default language setting" (see AppSettings.defaultLanguageCode).

PrayerKind.description: Discriminant for the type of a saved prayer session. Add a new case here (and a matching *Options type on Prayer) to expand into another devotion.
PrayerKind.note: The four-devotion rollout (Stations of the Cross, Franciscan Crown, Seven Sorrows, Divine Mercy Chaplet) is complete on all three platforms as of this case list.

RosaryOptions.description: Configuration specific to the Rosary. Lives inside a Prayer when kind == rosary.

specificMysteryGroup.description: Used when mysterySelectionMode == specific or singleMystery.

specificMysteryOrder.description: 1-based index into MysteryCatalog.forGroup(specificMysteryGroup) (always 5 mysteries per group). Used only when mysterySelectionMode == singleMystery.

includeOpeningPrayers.description: The opening Our Father + 3 Hail Marys (for faith, hope, charity) + Glory Be.

includeFatimaPrayer.description: "O my Jesus...", recited after the Glory Be of each decade.

presenterMode.description: Collapses each decade's 10 Hail Marys and its Glory Be onto one combined step (title "Hail Mary & Glory Be", body = both prayers' text) instead of 10 individual Hail Mary steps + a separate Glory Be step. Announcement and Our Father steps are unaffected. The combined step still sets hailMaryIndexInDecade = 10 so the bead-track UI renders the traditional 10-bead decade (see ARCHITECTURE.md).

cases.description: Follow the traditional weekday assignment (with liturgical-season overrides on Sundays).
Always pray a specific, user-chosen set regardless of the day.
Joyful, Sorrowful, and Glorious (no Luminous), prayed in one session.
All 20 mysteries in one session, chronological order: Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, Glorious.

Always pray exactly one specific mystery (one decade), chosen via specificMysteryGroup + specificMysteryOrder. Appended last on every platform: Windows persists this enum as a raw integer ordinal, so new cases must never be inserted mid-list.

EternalRestPlacement.description: Where (if at all) "Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord" is prayed for the faithful departed.

cases.description: After the Glory Be of every decade.
Once, near the end, before the closing prayers.

MarianAntiphonOption.description: Which closing Marian antiphon (if any) follows the Rosary.

cases.description: Pick the antiphon proper to the current liturgical season automatically.
The Church's oldest known Marian prayer; traditionally recited on its own, without a versicle/collect.

JesusPrayerOptions.description: Configuration specific to the Jesus Prayer. Lives inside a Prayer when kind == jesusPrayer.

JesusPrayerTarget.description: How many times the Jesus Prayer is prayed in a session.

cases.description: No target; the user ends the session explicitly.

JesusPrayerProgress.description: Live repetition counter during a Jesus Prayer session. Not persisted. Immutable on Android/Windows (copy/with-based updates); a mutable struct on iOS — a deliberate, known divergence, not a bug.

PrayerReminder.description: One saved daily reminder time. Not a recurrence rule by itself — see reminders.schedulingStrategy in screens.json's sibling ARCHITECTURE.md section for how each platform turns this into an actual repeating notification.

code.description: ISO 639-1, used as the key into the content layer's translation dictionaries.

RosaryStep.description: One prayer "bead" in a fully built session for any devotion — the output of PrayerEngine.buildSteps(for:). See ARCHITECTURE.md#engines.

subtitle.description: Decade context, e.g. "1st Mystery — The Annunciation".

isScripture.description: True only for the mystery-announcement step, whose body is a real quoted Bible verse.

decadeIndex.description: 0-based, counted globally across every mystery group in the session — never resets per group. What the bead track uses to tell decades apart.

imageOverrideKey.description: For steps not tied to a Mystery that still want a specific illustration — see mysteries.json's overrideImages.

languages.$ref: See LanguageCatalog.all in ARCHITECTURE.md — la (default), en, ar (RTL), he (RTL), ru, tl

persistence.perKindDefaultScoping: save()/delete() clear or promote isDefault scoped to Prayer.kind only, never across kinds — the one behavioral detail worth calling out explicitly, since it's easy to accidentally implement unscoped if a platform's store started out Rosary-only. See ARCHITECTURE.md#persistence.
